💡Frictionless Chains Meet Consumer Assets: TT Chain × REI Network

We're excited to connect TT Chain's asset-focused ecosystem — where real-world value like precious metals and income rights moves on-chain — with @GXChainGlobal, a lightweight, zero-fee, EVM-compatible blockchain built for frictionless Web3 development. 🌐

REI combines Ethereum compatibility with a Libp2p networking layer, upgradable system contracts, and a DPoS+BFT consensus for fast finality and eco-friendly performance. Its growing ecosystem spans DeFi, NFT, AI, and GameFi.

Through this collaboration, we explore how tokenized real-world assets might one day move across frictionless, gas-free rails — bridging tangible value with scalable, accessible infrastructure. 👏

The interesting thing about this commercial wasn't the bullet-time effect itself. 

It was how quickly the workflow could go from a basic 3D concept to something that feels ready for an actual ad edit. 

GPT-6 Astra created the white 3D model. 

I imported it into CapCut PC and used Seedance 2.5 to generate the cinematic footage. Then CapCut PC handled the post: speed changes, timing and the bullet-time effect. 

And if the generated sequence needed more work, I could use Edit Pilot or AI Extend rather than rebuilding everything from scratch. 

That's the productivity angle for me: AI accelerates the production, while CapCut PC keeps the final result in my hands.
